notes: Character → Statistics: everything the game counts for your character from its first day - quests, deaths, kills, gold, travel and more - with the change over the last seven days, a small graph of two weeks and the sum over all your characters. A box finds a statistic by its name.
Character → Legacy: your Legacy points, every challenge with how far it is, the nearest ones on top, and the zones this character has explored.
The addon has a new file: restart the game once after the update, then /reload.
